pieces.Text: As a standard action, a xtabay can release sleep-inducing pollen into the air around it.  Each creature within a 10-ft.-radius burst centered on the xtabay must make a DC

Will save or fall asleep for 1d3 minutes.  A creature that succeeds on the Fortitude save cannot be affected by the same xtabay's soporific pollen for 24 hours.  A creature put to sleep by this pollen can be awakened by vigorously shaking the sleeper (a standard action) or by damaging it.  This is a mind-affecting sleep effect.
